children.text: Enabled/satisfied state comes from MOISE, never an artifact return timestamp. Use engine event times rather than notification receipt times. Before first satisfaction bidCommittedBy follows current mission commitments; after it the set is frozen for this run. Do not replace commitments by all group participant players. Capture a baseline if attaching late; missing earlier evidence is unknown, not empty/false.
